name: Arduino Uno R4 Wifi Type-C Made In China

blocks.text: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi board MADE IN CHINA

The Arduino UNO R4 WiFi (China Version) is an advanced upgrade of the classic UNO platform, combining high-performance processing with integrated wireless connectivity. Built around a modern 32-bit microcontroller, it delivers significantly improved speed, memory, and functionality compared to previous UNO generations. The board maintains the familiar UNO form factor, making it compatible with a wide range of existing shields and accessories, while adding enhanced capabilities for modern applications.

One of the key highlights of this board is its integrated WiFi module, enabling seamless connection to cloud services, IoT platforms, and remote control systems without the need for external modules. It is ideal for developers, students, and hobbyists looking to build smart devices, connected sensors, and automation systems. The China version provides a cost-effective alternative while maintaining most of the core features and usability expected from the UNO R4 WiFi platform.
Built-in WiFi connectivity for IoT applications.
Improved processing performance over previous UNO versions.
Compatible with standard Arduino UNO shields.
USB interface for programming and power.
Suitable for beginners and advanced users.

blocks.text: This is 1-Channel Solid-State Relay Module, it is Arduino compatible. Solid-State Relay is some what similar to that of a mechanical relay & the difference is that, there is no moving contact in a Solid-State Relay. Here we make use of Phototriac coupler to turn it ON and OFF. It finds its application in AC circuits as a TRIAC has got only limited applications in DC. And with that, this relay is suitable to control AC load, not for DC load.

Solid state relays do have several advantages over mechanical relays. One such advantage is that they can be switched by a much lower voltage and at a much lower current than most mechanical relays. Also, because there’s no moving contacts, solid state relays can be switched much faster and for much longer periods without wearing out.

name: PN532 NFC/RFID Module 13.56MHz Read/Write – 43×41mm
desc: The PN532 NFC RFID Read Write Module provides 13.56MHz contactless communication for Arduino, ESP32, STM32, and Raspberry Pi projects. It supports I2C, SPI, and HSU interfaces with an integrated PCB antenna and a compact 43×41mm design.

blocks.text: PN532 NFC RFID Read Write Module

The PN532 NFC RFID Read Write Module is a versatile 13.56MHz contactless communication board based on the NXP PN532 controller. It can read and write compatible NFC tags and RFID cards. Therefore, it is an excellent choice for access-control, identification, attendance, automation, and interactive electronics projects.

The module includes an integrated PCB antenna and supports three communication interfaces: I2C, SPI, and High-Speed UART. As a result, you can connect it to many popular development platforms, including Arduino, ESP32, STM32, and Raspberry Pi.
Reads and writes compatible NFC/RFID tags

The PN532 NFC RFID Read Write Module can be used to build door-access systems, attendance machines, membership-card readers, payment prototypes, inventory systems, NFC-controlled equipment, smart locks, and interactive educational projects.

In addition, the module can read the UID and available data from supported tags. It can also write data to compatible writable cards and NFC tags when the selected library and tag permissions allow it.
Select the required interface using the switches on the module before connecting it to the controller. Then, connect the power and communication pins according to the selected I2C, SPI, or HSU mode.

The I2C and HSU interfaces share some connection pins. Therefore, always check the markings on the front and rear of the board. You should also restart the module after changing its communication mode.

Reading and writing capabilities depend on the card type, NFC tag, encryption, access keys, and software library. The module cannot freely modify every contactless card. Protected sectors on MIFARE cards require the correct authentication keys.

Communication distance also varies according to the tag size, antenna orientation, electrical noise, and installation conditions. For reliable operation, place the tag close and parallel to the onboard antenna.

name: NTAG213 Round NFC Sticker 13.56MHz 25mm – 5 Pieces
desc: The NTAG213 Round NFC Sticker 25mm is a programmable 13.56MHz passive tag for sharing links, contact details, identification data, and automation commands. Each package contains five adhesive NFC stickers with 144 bytes of user memory.

blocks.text: The NTAG213 Round NFC Sticker 25mm is a compact and programmable NFC tag based on the NXP NTAG213 chip. It operates at 13.56MHz and complies with the NFC Forum Type 2 Tag and ISO/IEC 14443 Type A standards.

The tag does not require a battery. Instead, it receives power wirelessly from a compatible NFC reader or smartphone. Therefore, it is easy to integrate into identification, automation, marketing, and interactive electronics applications.
Each package contains five round NFC inlay stickers with a diameter of approximately 25mm.
The NTAG213 Round NFC Sticker 25mm can store website links, social-media profiles, contact details, short text, product information, equipment IDs, and supported automation commands.
It is suitable for smart posters, digital business cards, product identification, inventory labels, attendance projects, interactive displays, Wi-Fi sharing, and NFC-enabled automation.
Moreover, the sticker can work with compatible PN532 modules and other 13.56MHz NFC readers that support ISO/IEC 14443A and NFC Forum Type 2 tags.

First, install a compatible NFC writing application on an NFC-enabled smartphone. Next, select the required record type, such as a website URL, contact card, text message, or automation command. Then, hold the phone close to the sticker until the writing process finishes.
You can rewrite the tag unless its memory has been permanently locked. Therefore, do not activate the permanent read-only option until you have tested the stored information.
Communication distance depends on the reader, antenna, phone, and installation environment. Place the tag close and parallel to the reading antenna for reliable performance.
Standard NFC inlay stickers may not work correctly when attached directly to metal surfaces. Use an anti-metal NFC tag or add a suitable insulating ferrite layer for metal installations.
Also, NTAG213 provides 144 bytes of user memory. It is not a direct replacement for NTAG215 or NTAG216 when an application requires their larger memory capacities.

name: NTAG215 NFC Card 13.56MHz – White PVC
desc: The NTAG215 White PVC NFC Card is a passive 13.56MHz programmable card with 504 bytes of user memory. It is ideal for sharing links, contact details, automation commands, identification data, and other compatible NFC applications.

blocks.text: The NTAG215 White PVC NFC Card is a programmable 13.56MHz contactless card for NFC projects. It uses the reliable NTAG215 chip and provides 504 bytes of usable read/write memory. Therefore, it offers enough space for website links, contact information, text, automation commands, and identification data.

The card operates without a battery. Instead, it receives power from the electromagnetic field generated by a compatible NFC phone or reader. As a result, it is convenient for everyday projects and requires no maintenance or charging.
Compatible with many NFC-enabled Android phones
Works with compatible NFC readers and writers

The NTAG215 White PVC NFC Card is suitable for many personal and professional applications. For example, you can program it with a website URL, digital business card, social media profile, Wi-Fi information, or contact details.

Additionally, the card can store commands for compatible smartphone automation applications. It can also support attendance systems, product identification, membership projects, exhibitions, access-management prototypes, and educational NFC experiments.

Its white PVC surface also makes the card suitable for labeling and custom identification. However, printing compatibility depends on the card printer and the surface coating. Therefore, confirm the supported printing method before printing directly onto the card.
You can program the card using an NFC-enabled Android phone and a compatible NFC writing application. Alternatively, you can use modules and readers that support NTAG215 and NFC Forum Type 2 tags.
First, enter the required information into the writing application. Next, place the phone or reader close to the card. Finally, complete the writing process and test the stored information.

The memory can remain rewritable or can be permanently locked. However, permanent locking cannot be reversed. For this reason, always verify the stored information before enabling read-only protection.

This product operates at 13.56MHz and is not compatible with 125kHz RFID readers. Furthermore, it cannot automatically copy encrypted bank cards, transportation cards, access cards, or other protected credentials.
Always confirm that your phone, reader, and software support the NTAG215 chip before ordering.

name: Mini ZVS Induction Heating Module 120W 5–12V DC with Coil
desc: The Mini ZVS Induction Heating Module 120W is a compact high-frequency heating board designed for heating small conductive metal parts without a direct flame. It operates from 5V to 12V DC and includes a detachable copper heating coil. Ideal for electronics experiments, DIY heating tools, educational demonstrations, and small metalworking applications.

blocks.text: The Mini ZVS Induction Heating Module 120W is a compact solution for heating small conductive metal objects using electromagnetic induction. Instead of using a flame or a conventional resistive heater, the module generates a high-frequency alternating magnetic field through the supplied copper coil. This field produces electrical currents inside the metal object, causing it to heat rapidly.

The board operates from a 5V to 12V DC power source. However, the maximum rated power of approximately 120W is achieved only when operating near 12V with a suitable high-current power supply. Therefore, a regulated 12V supply capable of delivering approximately 10A or more is recommended for high-power operation.

ZVS stands for Zero Voltage Switching. This switching method helps reduce power loss and switching stress on the MOSFETs compared with conventional hard-switching circuits. As a result, the module offers efficient high-frequency operation in a small and practical design.

The actual current consumption depends on the input voltage, the metal being heated, its size, its position inside the coil, and the operating time. Consequently, the module may draw significantly less than 120W during light use.
Input voltage range from 5V to 12V DC
Maximum rated power of approximately 120W at 12V
Supplied with a detachable copper heating coil
Fast, flame-free heating of small conductive metal parts
Compact module suitable for experimental projects
Suitable for DIY, laboratory, and educational applications
Can also be used as a ZVS driver for compatible experimental loads

blocks.v: Natural airflow or additional fan recommended

blocks.text: Connect the positive output of the DC power supply to the positive input terminal of the module. Then, connect the negative output to the negative input terminal. The supplied copper heating coil connects to the two output terminals on the board.
Always verify the polarity before applying power. Reversing the supply polarity can permanently damage the MOSFETs and other components.

The Mini ZVS Induction Heating Module 120W can be used for heating small screws, rods, nuts, wires, and other conductive metal components. In addition, it is suitable for electronics demonstrations, induction-heating experiments, small heat-treatment tests, and DIY workshop projects.
Performance varies according to the material. Ferromagnetic metals such as iron and steel generally heat more effectively than some non-ferrous metals when using a small module of this power level.

Use only a DC power supply within the specified voltage range. Never connect the module directly to 220V AC. Furthermore, do not exceed 12V unless the exact board version has been verified for a higher voltage.

The workpiece can become extremely hot within a short time. Therefore, use heat-resistant tools and keep hands, wires, batteries, and flammable materials away from the coil. Do not touch the coil or metal object during or immediately after operation.

For longer operating periods, provide forced-air cooling for the MOSFETs and board. It is also advisable to operate the module in short cycles and allow it to cool between tests. Finally, never power the board without the correct resonant coil securely connected.

name: RF-800 No-Clean Liquid Flux 125mL
desc: The RF-800 No-Clean Liquid Soldering Flux is supplied in a practical 125mL bottle for PCB assembly and electronics repair. It improves solder wetting and flow, helps produce clean solder joints, and is suitable for manual, dip, and wave soldering applications.

blocks.text: The RF-800 No-Clean Liquid Soldering Flux is designed for assembling, maintaining, and repairing electronic circuit boards. Its liquid consistency allows it to spread easily across component leads, PCB pads, and soldering areas.

Flux helps remove light surface oxidation during soldering. Moreover, it improves solder wetting and allows molten solder to flow more evenly. As a result, it can reduce common soldering problems such as weak joints, incomplete coverage, and solder bridges.
The 125mL bottle provides a practical quantity for electronics workshops, maintenance technicians, students, manufacturers, and DIY makers.
Helps produce smooth and reliable solder joints
Suitable for manual soldering and PCB repair
Can be used with dip and wave soldering processes
Compatible with through-hole and SMD components
Suitable for both leaded and lead-free soldering applications
Useful for PCB assembly, maintenance, and rework

The RF-800 No-Clean Liquid Soldering Flux is suitable for soldering electronic components, connectors, wires, PCB terminals, and circuit-board pads. It can also be used during electronics maintenance and component replacement.

For manual soldering, apply a small amount to the required soldering point. Then heat the joint with a suitable soldering iron and add the solder wire. The flux will help the solder spread across the metal surfaces.
Additionally, the liquid can be applied using a small brush, dropper, flux pen, spray system, or another controlled applicator. However, avoid applying more flux than required.

Because this is a no-clean flux, cleaning is normally unnecessary after correct application. Nevertheless, visible residue can be removed using a suitable electronics-grade PCB cleaner or isopropyl alcohol when required.
Always close the bottle securely after use. Also, store it in a cool and ventilated location away from sunlight, heat, sparks, and open flames.
Use the product only in a well-ventilated work area. Avoid direct contact with the eyes and skin. Furthermore, keep it away from children and do not use it near flames.
This product is intended for electronics soldering. Therefore, it should not be used as plumbing flux or for flame and fusion welding.

name: 8mm PVC Water Pump Hose for 12V Pumps
desc: The 8mm PVC Water Pump Hose is a flexible tube designed for the white and black 12V water pumps. It provides a secure connection for transferring water in robotics, cooling, irrigation, aquarium, and DIY pumping projects.

blocks.text: The 8mm PVC Water Pump Hose is a practical and flexible tube for small water-transfer projects. It is compatible with the common white and black 12V water pumps that use an 8mm hose connection.

The hose connects directly to the pump outlet or inlet. Therefore, it provides a simple way to guide water between a tank, container, pump, or project enclosure. Its flexible PVC construction also makes routing the hose around components and inside compact projects easier.
Compatible with the white 12V water pump
Compatible with the black 12V water pump
Easy to cut to the required length
Useful for DIY and educational projects

The 8mm PVC Water Pump Hose can be used in automatic plant-watering systems, small irrigation projects, aquarium water circulation, electronic cooling projects, water-level experiments, smart-home projects, and educational kits.
In addition, it works well with Arduino, ESP32, and other controller-based projects when the water pump is operated through a suitable relay or motor driver.

First, cut the hose to the required length using a suitable cutter. Next, push the hose firmly over the pump nozzle. If the connection feels loose or the project operates for long periods, secure it using a suitable hose clamp or cable tie.
Before operating the system, check the connection for water leakage. Also, avoid sharp bends because they can restrict water flow and reduce pump performance.

name: MT87 Digital AC Clamp Meter 400A
desc: The MT87 Digital AC Clamp Meter is a compact 2000-count electrical testing instrument. It measures AC current up to 400A without disconnecting the circuit. In addition, it measures AC/DC voltage, resistance, continuity, and diodes using the supplied test probes.

blocks.text: The MT87 Digital AC Clamp Meter is a compact and practical measuring instrument for electrical maintenance, installation, and troubleshooting. It measures AC current by clamping around a single insulated conductor. Therefore, you can check current without cutting the wire or connecting the meter in series with the circuit.

The clamp meter provides three AC current ranges: 20A, 200A, and 400A. In addition, the supplied test probes allow you to measure DC voltage up to 600V and AC voltage up to 450V. The meter can also test resistance, continuity, and diodes.
MT87 Digital AC Clamp Meter Features

The MT87 Digital AC Clamp Meter is suitable for electricians, maintenance technicians, students, and DIY users. It can help test electrical panels, lighting circuits, appliances, power supplies, workshop equipment, and AC loads.
Moreover, the compact body makes it easy to carry inside a toolbox. The rotary selector also provides quick access to the required measurement mode.

For AC current measurement, clamp the meter around only one conductor. Do not clamp around both the live and neutral wires together because their magnetic fields cancel each other and produce an incorrect reading.
The clamp section measures AC current only. It does not measure DC current through the clamp. However, the test probes can measure both AC and DC voltage.

Always select the correct function and range before starting. Also, inspect the meter and probes for damage. Never exceed the specified measurement limits, and use extra caution when working on live electrical circuits.

name: Black V2.1 OBD2 ELM327
desc: The ELM327 V2.1 Bluetooth OBD2 Scanner connects compatible OBD-II vehicles to Android devices and Windows computers. Use a compatible diagnostic application to read and clear engine fault codes, monitor supported live data, and check basic vehicle information wirelessly.

blocks.text: The ELM327 V2.1 Bluetooth OBD2 Scanner is a compact wireless adapter for basic vehicle diagnostics. It connects to the standard OBD-II port and sends supported vehicle data to a compatible Android device or Windows computer through Bluetooth.

After connecting the scanner, you can use a compatible diagnostic application to read engine fault codes. You can also clear supported Check Engine codes and monitor available live sensor data. Therefore, it provides a practical and affordable solution for vehicle owners, technicians, and automotive electronics projects.
ELM327 V2.1 Bluetooth OBD2 Scanner Features
Connects directly to a standard 16-pin OBD-II port
Reads supported engine diagnostic trouble codes
Clears supported Check Engine fault codes
Status LEDs for power and communication activity
Suitable for Android devices and Bluetooth-enabled Windows computers
Works with many ELM327-compatible diagnostic applications

Available functions depend on the vehicle, ECU, and selected application. Common functions may include engine RPM, coolant temperature, vehicle speed, calculated engine load, intake temperature, throttle position, fuel-system information, and supported diagnostic trouble codes.
How to Use the OBD2 Scanner

First, turn off the vehicle and locate its 16-pin OBD-II connector. Next, plug the adapter firmly into the diagnostic port. Turn on the ignition, then pair the scanner with your Android device or Windows computer. Finally, open a compatible OBD2 application and select the appropriate Bluetooth connection.

The ELM327 V2.1 Bluetooth OBD2 Scanner is intended mainly for standard engine and emissions diagnostics. It may not access manufacturer-specific systems such as ABS, airbags, immobilizers, body-control modules, or transmission systems.

Vehicle compatibility and available data vary according to the vehicle model, production year, ECU, protocol, and diagnostic application. In addition, most Bluetooth Classic versions work with Android and Windows but may not connect directly to iPhone or iPad devices. Always confirm vehicle and application compatibility before purchasing.

name: Blue ELM327 V1.5 Bluetooth OBD2 Scanner
desc: The Blue ELM327 V1.5 Bluetooth OBD2 Scanner connects compatible vehicles to Android devices for basic engine diagnostics. It can read and clear supported fault codes, display live sensor data, and monitor vehicle parameters using a compatible OBD2 application.

blocks.text: Blue ELM327 V1.5 Bluetooth OBD2 Scanner

The Blue ELM327 V1.5 Bluetooth OBD2 Scanner is a compact wireless diagnostic adapter for vehicles equipped with a compatible OBD-II port. It connects the vehicle’s diagnostic system to an Android phone, tablet, or compatible Windows device through Classic Bluetooth.

This adapter provides an affordable method for checking basic engine information without using a large diagnostic tool. Therefore, it is useful for car owners, technicians, students, and automotive electronics projects.
Monitors engine speed and vehicle speed
Can display coolant temperature and calculated engine load
Powered directly through the vehicle’s OBD2 port
Requires no separate battery or charging cable
Blue plastic housing with compact construction
Available readings depend on the vehicle, its ECU, and the diagnostic application being used.

The Blue ELM327 V1.5 Bluetooth OBD2 Scanner can read generic engine diagnostic trouble codes on supported vehicles. Moreover, it can clear certain stored engine codes after the original problem has been repaired.
A compatible application may also display live parameters such as engine RPM, vehicle speed, coolant temperature, intake-air temperature, throttle position, fuel-system status, and calculated load.
However, not every vehicle provides all these readings. Access to ABS, airbag, transmission, immobilizer, service-reset, and manufacturer-specific systems is also not guaranteed.
How to Use the OBD2 Adapter
First, locate the OBD-II diagnostic port inside the vehicle. Next, connect the adapter while the vehicle is safely parked. Turn the ignition on and activate Bluetooth on your Android device.

Pair the adapter with the phone or tablet. Then open a compatible OBD2 application and select the Bluetooth connection. Finally, choose the ELM327 adapter and allow the application to connect to the vehicle ECU.
Applications such as Torque and Car Scanner may be used, depending on the operating system and vehicle.

This model normally uses Classic Bluetooth. Therefore, it is intended mainly for Android and compatible Windows devices. Standard Classic Bluetooth versions are generally not compatible with iPhones or iPads. For iOS devices, use a confirmed Bluetooth Low Energy or Wi-Fi OBD2 adapter.
The vehicle must support standard OBD-II diagnostics. Having the same 16-pin connector alone does not guarantee compatibility.
This product is intended for basic diagnostics and live-data monitoring. It is not a replacement for a professional dealership diagnostic system.
Do not clear fault codes before identifying and repairing the problem. Also, avoid leaving the adapter permanently connected when the vehicle is parked for long periods.

name: Lithium Battery Charger 3S 12.6V 2A – 5.5×2.1mm Plug
desc: The 12.6V 2A 3S Lithium Battery Charger provides reliable charging for compatible 3-cell lithium-ion battery packs. It delivers a 12.6V charging output at up to 2A and features a standard 5.5×2.1mm DC connector. Ideal for rechargeable 11.1V nominal battery packs used in electronics, robotics, lighting, and DIY projects.

blocks.text: The 12.6V 2A 3S Lithium Battery Charger is designed for charging compatible three-cell lithium-ion battery packs. A 3S lithium battery has an 11.1V nominal voltage and reaches 12.6V when fully charged. Therefore, this adapter provides the correct final charging voltage for compatible 3S packs.

The charger delivers up to 2A of charging current. As a result, it offers a practical balance between charging speed and everyday reliability. The output cable includes a standard 5.5×2.1mm DC barrel connector for easy connection to compatible battery packs and electronic equipment.
Main Features of the 12.6V 2A 3S Lithium Battery Charger
Suitable for 11.1V nominal lithium battery packs
Useful for electronics, robotics, lighting, and DIY projects

This charger works well with compatible rechargeable battery packs used in robotic projects, portable electronic devices, LED lighting systems, security equipment, and custom power solutions. In addition, it can replace a damaged charger when its voltage, current, connector size, and polarity match the original unit.
Use this charger only with compatible 3S lithium-ion battery packs that charge to 12.6V. The battery pack should include a suitable 3S Battery Management System for protection and cell balancing.

Before connecting the charger, check the DC connector size and polarity. Moreover, confirm that the battery supports a charging current of up to 2A. Do not use this adapter with 1S, 2S, or 4S batteries. Also, never charge damaged, swollen, overheated, or unprotected lithium cells.

name: Step-Down Transformer 220VAC to 3.3VAC 300mA
desc: The 220VAC to 3.3VAC Step-Down Transformer converts mains AC voltage into an isolated 3.3VAC output. It supplies up to 300mA with an approximate rating of 1VA. Therefore, it suits low-voltage control circuits, indicators and electronic power-supply projects.

blocks.text: The 220VAC to 3.3VAC Step-Down Transformer reduces mains voltage to a low-voltage AC output. Its primary winding accepts approximately 220VAC. Meanwhile, the secondary winding provides 3.3VAC at a maximum rated current of 300mA.
The transformer has an approximate apparent-power rating of 0.99VA, which is commonly rounded to 1VA. Therefore, it suits low-power electronic circuits that require a small isolated AC supply.

This component provides electrical isolation between its primary and secondary windings. However, correct installation and insulation remain essential because the primary side connects directly to hazardous mains voltage.
The secondary output provides 3.3 volts AC, not regulated 3.3 volts DC. Consequently, circuits that require DC power need an additional rectifier, smoothing capacitor and voltage-regulation stage.

The final DC voltage depends on the rectifier type, diode voltage drop, capacitor value and connected load. Therefore, designers should test the complete power-supply circuit before connecting sensitive electronic components.
AC output for rectification or direct AC loads

The 220VAC to 3.3VAC Step-Down Transformer can power low-voltage AC circuits, control boards and small indicators. Additionally, it can form the first stage of a low-current DC power supply when used with suitable rectification and regulation components.
It also suits maintenance, prototyping and educational power-supply projects. Nevertheless, only trained users should work with the primary side.

For safe installation, add a correctly rated fuse to the mains input. Moreover, cover all exposed primary terminals with suitable insulation. Always disconnect the power before touching, wiring or modifying the circuit.

name: MC4 Solar Connector Male and Female Pair – 4mm Contact
desc: The MC4 Solar Connector Male Female Pair provides a secure connection between compatible solar panel cables. The pair includes male and female housings, metal crimp contacts and sealing components. Its locking design helps prevent accidental disconnection in photovoltaic projects.

blocks.text: MC4 Solar Connector Male Female Pair

The MC4 Solar Connector Male Female Pair provides a secure cable connection for photovoltaic systems. The set includes one male connector and one female connector. Therefore, it can join compatible solar cables between panels, extension leads and other PV equipment.

Each connector includes a plastic housing, metal crimp contact and cable sealing components. The locking mechanism holds the pair together during normal operation. In addition, the sealed construction helps protect the electrical contact from dust and moisture when users assemble and mate the connectors correctly.

MC4 refers to a connector system that uses a 4mm contact pin. However, the required PV cable cross-section and outside diameter depend on the connector version. Always check that the cable, metal contact and sealing gland match before installation.
Installing the MC4 Solar Connector Pair

First, strip the solar cable according to the connector’s required length. Next, insert the conductor into the correct metal contact. Use a suitable MC4 crimping tool to form a secure mechanical and electrical connection.

After crimping, push the contact into its matching housing until it locks. Then, tighten the cable gland to compress the seal around the cable. Finally, connect the male and female housings and confirm that the locking tabs engage correctly.
One male and one female solar connector
Locking connection to prevent accidental separation
Cable glands and sealing components included
Supports forward cable extensions and panel connections
Easy to assemble with compatible crimping tools

The MC4 Solar Connector Male Female Pair suits solar panel installations, PV extension cables and portable solar systems. Additionally, it can support small off-grid projects, solar battery chargers and renewable-energy experiments.

For safe operation, never connect or disconnect the pair while current flows through the circuit. Also, use matching connectors from the same compatible product family. Mixing different connector brands or types may create a poor contact, overheating or connection failure.
Finally, confirm the cable size, voltage and current requirements before installation. A qualified technician should handle high-voltage solar arrays.

name: Nickel Strip 0.15 × 8mm for 18650 Lithium Batteries – 1 Meter
desc: The 18650 Nickel Strip 0.15x8mm provides a practical connection material for assembling and repairing lithium battery packs. It comes in a 1-meter length and supports spot welding onto 18650 battery terminals, allowing users to cut the required length for each pack configuration.

blocks.text: The 18650 Nickel Strip 0.15x8mm provides a practical connection between lithium battery cells. It comes in a total length of 1 meter. Therefore, users can cut it according to the required battery pack layout.

The strip measures 0.15mm in thickness and 8mm in width. This size offers a useful balance between flexibility, strength and weldability. In addition, the flat surface provides good contact with common cylindrical battery terminals.

This battery strip works best with a suitable battery spot-welding machine. Spot welding creates a connection using short energy pulses. As a result, it reduces the amount of heat transferred into the battery cell.

The strip can connect cells in series or parallel configurations. However, the electrical arrangement depends on the required battery voltage and capacity. A suitable BMS must also match the number of cells and the intended current.

Before welding, clean the cell terminals and cut the required strip length. Then, position the strip flat against each terminal. Finally, adjust the spot welder according to the strip thickness and test the setting on a spare piece.
Easy to cut for custom battery layouts
Flat profile for stable terminal contact
Useful for series and parallel cell connections
Suitable for battery pack assembly and repair

The 18650 Nickel Strip 0.15x8mm mainly suits cylindrical 18650 lithium-ion cells. Additionally, it may fit other cylindrical battery sizes when their terminal dimensions and required current match the strip.
Use this strip for custom lithium battery packs, power banks and portable electronics. It also suits battery repairs, robotics power systems and DIY energy-storage projects.
For safety, never short-circuit the battery terminals. Moreover, use insulated tools and a compatible BMS. Avoid prolonged direct soldering onto lithium cells because excessive heat may damage them.

This compact module accepts power from a standard 5V USB Type-C supply. Its integrated step-up charging circuit increases the input voltage to the correct charging voltage for a 2S lithium battery pack. Therefore, it provides a convenient charging solution for portable electronics, robotics, DIY power systems, and rechargeable projects.
Features of the 2S 8.4V USB Type-C Lithium Battery Charger Module

The board includes a modern USB Type-C input, making it easy to power from a suitable USB adapter or power bank. It also provides solder pads for a wired power input when a USB connection is not required.

Onboard status LEDs indicate the charging condition. The CR indicator normally shows that charging is active, while the OK indicator shows that the battery has reached full charge or the board has entered constant-voltage mode.

name: Power Bank Module Type C USB 5V 2A Boost Converter
desc: USB Type-C 5V 2A Power Bank Module for charging a single 3.7V lithium battery and converting its voltage to a regulated 5V USB output. It includes battery protection, LED level indicators, automatic low-load shutdown, and a maximum output current of 2A.

blocks.text: The USB Type-C 5V 2A Power Bank Module combines lithium battery charging, battery protection, and a 5V boost converter on one compact board. It is suitable for building DIY power banks, portable electronic devices, rechargeable development-board supplies, and battery-powered projects.

The module works with a single 3.7V lithium-ion, 18650, or lithium-polymer battery. It accepts a 5V charging supply through its USB Type-C input and charges the connected battery to the appropriate final voltage. During discharge, the boost converter raises the battery voltage to a regulated 5V output with a maximum rated current of 2A.
Features of the USB Type-C 5V 2A Power Bank Module
The board includes integrated charging management and protection functions. These features help protect the battery against overcharging, excessive discharge, output overcurrent, and short circuits.

Four onboard LED indicators provide an approximate indication of the remaining battery charge. An optional external push button can also be connected to the K control pad for manually activating or deactivating the output and battery indicators.

Maximum performance depends on the battery, USB power adapter, cable quality, wiring thickness, temperature, and connected load. A suitable high-discharge battery and short, thick battery wires are required when operating near the maximum output current.

Charging normally ends after the battery reaches its final voltage and the charging current falls to approximately 100mA. The charging process automatically restarts if the battery voltage falls below approximately 4.1V.
When a deeply discharged battery is below approximately 2.8V, the module may begin with a low-current pre-charge cycle before normal charging starts.

The 5V output automatically switches off when the connected load continuously draws less than approximately 50mA. Therefore, the module may not remain active with extremely low-power sensors or devices.
Connect the battery positive terminal to B+ and the negative terminal to B−. Check the polarity carefully before applying power.

Only use compatible 3.7V rechargeable lithium batteries. Multiple matching cells may be connected in parallel to increase capacity, but they must have the same voltage and condition before connection. Never connect batteries in series because a series battery pack will damage the module.

desc: The 1–8S Li-Po Battery Voltage Tester displays the total pack voltage and individual cell voltages through the balance connector. It also provides an adjustable low-voltage buzzer alarm for compatible 2–8S lithium battery packs.

The tester connects directly to the battery’s compatible balance connector. Therefore, it requires no external power supply or separate battery. Its bright LED display makes the readings easy to check during battery testing, maintenance, and RC applications.
In addition, the built-in dual buzzer provides a loud warning when a monitored cell falls below the selected alarm level.
Low-voltage alarm mode for compatible 2–8S packs

Its stated voltage-detection precision is approximately ±0.01V. However, it should be used as a convenient field checker rather than a substitute for calibrated laboratory measuring equipment.

name: BZX79-C4V7 4.7V Voltage Regulator Zener Diode
desc: The BZX79-C4V7 4.7V Voltage Regulator Zener Diode is a 500mW axial component designed for voltage stabilization, reference circuits, signal limiting, and low-power protection applications. It features an approximately ±5% voltage tolerance and a compact DO-35 glass package.

blocks.text: The BZX79-C4V7 4.7V Voltage Regulator Zener Diode is a low-power semiconductor component designed to maintain an approximately stable voltage when operated in its reverse-breakdown region.

It provides a nominal Zener voltage of 4.7V at the specified test current. Therefore, it is suitable for voltage-reference circuits, basic voltage stabilization, signal clipping, level limiting, and low-power protection applications.

The diode is supplied in a compact hermetically sealed axial glass package. Its through-hole leads make it suitable for breadboards, prototype boards, educational circuits, maintenance work, and conventional printed circuit boards.
Package: SOD27, commonly identified as DO-35
Easy to use in prototypes and PCB circuits

The BZX79-C4V7 4.7V Voltage Regulator Zener Diode can provide a basic voltage reference for transistor, sensor, and analog circuits. Additionally, it can be used for signal clipping and limiting when the circuit requires a voltage near 4.7V.

It is also useful in low-current shunt-regulator circuits and input-protection networks. However, the diode is not a replacement for a high-current voltage regulator, TVS diode, or complete power-supply protection circuit.
A Zener diode is normally connected in reverse bias for voltage regulation. The cathode is identified by the band printed around one side of the glass body.

For a typical regulator circuit, connect the cathode toward the positive supply and the anode toward ground. Moreover, a correctly calculated series resistor must be connected to limit the current through the diode.
When used in forward bias, the component behaves similarly to a standard silicon diode. However, its main intended function is reverse-breakdown voltage regulation.
The 4.7V value is nominal and is measured under specified test conditions. The actual voltage can vary with current, component tolerance, temperature, and circuit design.
Always calculate the series resistor according to the input voltage, load current, required Zener current, and power dissipation. Furthermore, do not exceed the maximum 500mW power rating.
This product is supplied as one individual diode unless another quantity is selected.

How to Use the M&R SW07 Air Blower

First, switch off and disconnect the equipment before cleaning it. Next, point the nozzle toward the dusty area while maintaining a safe distance. Then, squeeze the pump several times to direct short bursts of air onto the surface.
For better results, hold the equipment at an angle so displaced dust can escape. However, do not allow the nozzle to touch camera sensors, lenses, circuit boards, or other sensitive parts.

The M&R K-02 Soldering Iron Tip Cleaner is a practical accessory for cleaning and maintaining soldering iron tips. It uses curled brass cleaning wire to remove excess solder, light oxidation, burnt flux, and other residue from a hot soldering tip.

Unlike a wet sponge, this cleaner does not require water. Therefore, it cleans the tip without causing a sudden temperature drop. This helps the soldering iron recover faster and remain ready for the next solder joint.

The cleaner includes a stable metal holder that keeps the brass wire securely in place. In addition, the internal wire captures removed solder particles and keeps them away from the work surface. How to Use the Soldering Tip Cleaner
First, heat the soldering iron to its normal working temperature. Next, insert the hot tip gently into the brass wire. Use a light twisting movement, then remove the tip.
Repeat the process only when necessary. After cleaning, apply a small amount of fresh solder to the tip. This process is known as tinning, and it helps protect the tip surface from rapid oxidation.
Do not push the tip forcefully into the cleaner. Furthermore, avoid aggressive scraping because it may damage the protective plating on the soldering tip.
The holder and brass wire may become hot during use. Therefore, allow the cleaner to cool before emptying solder residue or replacing the wire.
Place the cleaner on a stable, heat-resistant surface. Also, keep it away from flammable materials. Replace the brass wire when it becomes heavily contaminated or no longer cleans effectively.

name: 3D Printer Heat Bed High Power MOSFET Module 25A
desc: The Heat Bed High Power MOSFET Module 25A is a power expansion board for controlling high-current 3D-printer heated beds. It transfers the heavy electrical load from the printer motherboard to an external MOSFET, helping protect the motherboard connectors from overheating or damage.

blocks.text: Heat Bed High Power MOSFET Module 25A

The Heat Bed High Power MOSFET Module 25A is designed to safely control high-current heated beds in 3D printers. Instead of passing the full heated-bed current through the printer motherboard, the module draws power directly from the external power supply.

The printer control board only sends the switching signal. Therefore, the heavy electrical load passes through the external MOSFET module. This arrangement helps reduce stress on motherboard terminals, connectors, and onboard MOSFET components.

The module supports common 12V and 24V 3D-printer systems. In addition, its large aluminum heatsink improves heat dissipation during operation. It is especially useful when installing a larger heated bed or replacing a standard bed with a higher-power model.

The 25A value is the module’s maximum rating and should not be treated as a guaranteed continuous current under every installation condition. Continuous high-current operation may require additional airflow or a 30mm cooling fan.

blocks.text: The KY-039 Heartbeat Sensor Module is a compact optical sensor designed for educational pulse-detection projects. It uses an infrared LED and a phototransistor to detect small changes in the amount of light passing through a fingertip.

A connected microcontroller can then sample and process this signal to detect pulse peaks and estimate the heart rate in beats per minute.
The module does not calculate BPM internally. Therefore, the microcontroller program must filter the raw signal, detect each pulse peak, and calculate the time between consecutive beats.

BD140 PNP Bipolar Power Transistor TO-126 (1.5A, 80V)

The BD140 is a PNP Epitaxial Planar Transistor that is mounted in the TO-126 plastic package. They are designed for audio amplifiers and drivers utilizing complementary or quasi-complementary circuits. The NPN complement is BD139 and this transistor comes with a VCE of -80V and a continuous collector current of -1.5A. It can be used as a small signal switching transistor. Moreover, it has a low base voltage of -5V.

blocks.v: Emitter · Current Drains out through emitter, normally connected to ground
Collector · Current flows in through collector, normally connected to load
Base · Controls the biasing of the transistor, used to turn ON or OFF the transistor.

blocks.text: Note: Complete Technical Details can be found in the BD140 datasheet given at the end of this page.

The BD140 transistor is a very versatile transistor that can be used in many different applications. This is a PNP transistor hence its collector and emitter will be left open when a positive voltage is applied to the base of the transistor, and it will close when no voltage is present on the base.

The Beta value of this transistor can be anywhere between 40 to 160, this parameter determines the amplification factor of the device, the max rated current for this transistor is 1.5A. So we can connect a load up to 1.5A but we do need to consider the power rating and the temperature. This transistor has a maxim base-emitter voltage of 5V that means it can be suitably used for logic level application in embedded system.

When this transistor is in a biased condition, it can allow a maximum of 1.5A through its emitter-collector junction, this state of the device is called the saturation state, flowing more current than 1.5A can damage the device. When the base current is removed the transistor becomes fully off, this stage is called the Cut-off Region so no current flows through the device. The BD140 was originally manufactured by Phillips rated at 160MHz for specific audio applications, later they were cloned by other manufacturers like Samsung, ST, ON Semi, etc.

Transistors are current-controlled devices so to turn them on a little current is needed. For the BD140 Transistor, this base current is less than 10mA, as BD140 is a PNP transistor that means it will be on when the base is connected to the ground, and it will be off when a positive voltage is applied to the base of the transistor.
The simulated circuit below shows how this transistor behaves when the base of the basic circuit is connected to the ground and when it’s connected to 12V of the power supply.

When we turn on the transistor by connecting the base to the ground the transistor will remain on unless the voltage at the base of the transistor reaches more than the base turn-off voltage, for this transistor, it is somewhere in between 0.7 -0.9V. The base of the transistor cannot be left floating otherwise there could be false triggering, which may lead to issues in the circuit. To resolve this issue, we need to add pullup resistors as shown in the example, a 10K resistor is used to pull up the base of the transistor to VCC.

blocks.text: Note: Complete Technical Details can be found in the BD139 transistor datasheet provided at the bottom of this page.

BD139 is an NPN transistor hence the collector and emitter will be left open (Reverse biased) when the base pin is held at ground and will be closed (Forward biased) when a signal is provided to the base pin

BD139 has a gain value of 40 to 160, this value determines the amplification capacity of the transistor. The maximum amount of current that could flow through the Collector pin is 1.5A, hence we cannot connect loads that consume more than 1.5A using this transistor. To bias a transistor we have to supply current to the base pin, this current (IB) should be limited to 1/10th of the collector current, and the voltage across the base-emitter pin should be 5V maximum.

When this transistor is fully biased then it can allow a maximum of 1.5A to flow across the collector and emitter. This stage is called Saturation Region and the typical voltage allowed across the Collector-Emitter (V­CE) or Base-Emitter (VBE) could be 80V. When the base current is removed the transistor becomes fully off, this stage is called as the Cut-off Region.
The BD139 was originally manufactured by Phillips rated at 160MHz for specific audio applications, later they were cloned by other manufacturers like Samsung, ST etc.

Being a Medium Power NPN Transistor with a collector current of 1.5A this transistor can be used to control (On/Off) bigger loads that consume less than 1.5A. It also has a very low saturation voltage (Base Emitter Voltage VBE) of only 5V, which makes it easy to use this IC in digital electronics which has an operating voltage of 5V.

Another peculiar fact about this transistor is that it comes in a plastic package, while most medium power transistors are available only in the metal can package. This reduces the cost of the Transistor and also since the package is not conductive it will not be affected by other noise in the circuit. Due to this feature this transistor is widely used in amplifier applications.
So if you are looking for a medium-power NPN transistor in a Plastic package then this Transistor might be the right choice for you.

Flex sensors are sensors that change in resistance depending on the amount of bend on the sensor. They convert the change in bend to electrical resistance – the more the bend, the more the resistance value. When the sensor straightens out again, the resistance returns to the original value. By measuring the resistance, you can determine how much the sensor is being bent.
They are usually in the form of a thin strip that vary in resistance from approximately 10 to 50 kilohms when the sensor is bent to 90º.

Flex sensors are used in gaming gloves, auto controls, fitness products, measuring devices, assistive technology, musical instruments, joysticks, and more. These sensors were used in the original Nintendo Power Glove.

blocks.text: MCP2515 TJA1050 CAN Bus SPI Module
The MCP2515 TJA1050 CAN Bus SPI Module lets a microcontroller send and receive data over a CAN network. It combines the MCP2515 stand-alone CAN controller with the TJA1050 high-speed CAN transceiver.
The MCP2515 communicates with the host controller through SPI. Therefore, you can add CAN Bus communication to boards that do not include a built-in CAN controller.
In addition, the module supports CAN 2.0B standard and extended frames. It also supports communication speeds up to 1Mbps when the network wiring and software configuration allow it.
Maximum CAN data rate up to 1Mbps
The module suits many CAN communication projects. For example, you can use it to connect multiple controllers, sensors, or embedded devices over the same network.
The module normally operates from a 5V supply. Therefore, you can connect it easily to 5V Arduino boards.

However, use a suitable logic-level converter when connecting the SPI pins to 3.3V controllers such as many ESP32 and STM32 boards. This step protects the controller inputs from potentially unsafe 5V logic levels.

Also, install termination resistance only at the two physical ends of the CAN network. If your network already has the required termination, check whether the module allows you to disconnect its onboard 120Ω resistor.

name: 74HC164 – 74164 ( 8 Bit Serial In Parallel Out Shift Register )

blocks.text: These 8-bit shift registers feature gated serial inputs and an asynchronous clear.
A low logic level at either input inhibits entry of the new data, and resets the first flip-flop to the low level at the next clock pulse, thus providing complete control over incoming data.
A high logic level on either input enables the other input, which will then determine the state of the first flip-flop.
Data at the serial inputs may be changed while the clock is HIGH or LOW, but only information meeting the setup and hold time requirements will be entered.
Clocking occurs on the LOW-to-HIGH level transition of the clock input.
All inputs are diode-clamped to minimize transmission-line effects.

name: Servo Motor MG995 360 Degree ( Metal Gear )

blocks.text: MG995 Servo Motor Tower Pro Continuous Rotation (Full Metal Gear)

The MG995 Tower Pro Continuous Rotation Servo Motor is a high-performance, durable servo designed for applications that require full 360-degree continuous motion. Unlike standard servo motors that rotate to a specific angle (e.g., 0° to 180°), this version of the MG995 is modified to provide continuous rotation, making it ideal for wheeled robots, conveyor systems, mobile platforms, and other projects requiring bidirectional speed control.

Equipped with full metal gears, including strong brass and steel components, the MG995 is built to handle mechanical stress and heavy loads without gear wear or failure. Its robust internal structure allows for higher torque output — up to 12 kg·cm at 6V — which is particularly beneficial for mobile robotics or lifting mechanisms. The inclusion of dual ball bearings enhances smooth motion and longevity, even under frequent or high-load usage.

This servo is controlled using a PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) signal, but instead of controlling position, the pulse length controls the speed and direction of rotation. A 1.5 ms pulse stops the motor, pulses shorter than 1.5 ms make it spin in one direction, and pulses longer than 1.5 ms make it spin in the opposite direction. The further the pulse deviates from 1.5 ms, the faster the motor spins.

The MG995 continuous rotation servo operates at a voltage range of 4.8V to 7.2V, with a typical operating speed of around 0.14–0.20 sec/60° equivalent, depending on voltage. Its standard 3-wire interface (orange for signal, red for VCC, and brown for GND) makes it easily compatible with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and RC controllers.
In summary, the MG995 Continuous Rotation Servo Motor is a powerful, reliable, and affordable solution for motion control in DIY robotics, smart automation, and RC-based projects.
Full 360° Continuous Rotation: Moves freely in either direction — ideal for wheels, conveyor belts, or rotating platforms.

Powerful Torque for Heavy Loads: Can move or drive heavier objects with ease — great for mobile robots or lifting systems.

Plug-and-Play with Arduino & RC: Connects easily to common platforms like Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or RC controllers — no complicated setup.
Stays in Motion Until You Tell It to Stop: Unlike regular servos, it keeps spinning as long as you send the right signal.
Compact and Fits Anywhere: Small enough to fit in tight spaces while still offering strong output.
Affordable and Beginner-Friendly: Offers high performance for a low cost, making it ideal for students, hobbyists, and prototype projects.
Great for DIY Robotics and Smart Projects: Perfect for smart cars, automatic doors, animatronics, and other creative builds.

desc: The LM317CV Adjustable Voltage Regulator provides a selectable positive output from approximately 1.2V to 37V. It supports loads up to 1.5A under suitable cooling and operating conditions.

blocks.text: The LM317CV is a three-terminal positive linear voltage regulator in a TO-220 package. It allows designers to set the output voltage with only two external resistors.

In addition, the regulator includes current limiting, thermal shutdown, and safe-operating-area protection. Therefore, it offers a practical solution for adjustable power supplies, current regulators, and electronic prototypes.
Requires only two resistors for voltage adjustment
Provides good line and load regulation
Regulator Type: Adjustable Positive Linear Regulator
When viewing the printed face of the TO-220 package with the pins pointing downward:
ADJUST: Connects to the voltage-setting resistor network
OUTPUT: Provides the regulated output voltage
INPUT: Connects to the unregulated positive supply
The metal tab also connects electrically to the output pin. Therefore, use an insulating pad when mounting several devices on the same heatsink if their outputs differ.
Use two resistors to set the output voltage:
VOUT = VREF × (1 + R2 ÷ R1) + IADJ × R2
For most basic calculations, you can use this simplified formula:
A common design uses a 240Ω resistor for R1. Then, choose a fixed resistor or potentiometer for R2 to obtain the required output voltage.
The LM317CV is a linear regulator. Therefore, it cannot increase voltage, and its input must remain higher than the selected output.
For reliable regulation, provide approximately 2–3V of voltage headroom. For example, a regulated 9V output normally requires an input of about 11–12V.
The regulator converts excess voltage into heat. As a result, high current or a large voltage difference requires an adequate heatsink.
You can estimate the generated heat with this formula:
For example, regulating 12V down to 5V at 1A produces approximately 7W of heat. This operating condition requires substantial cooling.
For stable operation, use the components recommended for your circuit:
10µF capacitor between ADJUST and ground for improved ripple rejection
Protection diodes when using large output or adjustment capacitors

Product Description: Character LCD display 2×16 characters

Alphanumeric LCD display. It presents values in two lines, 16 characters in each . It is powered by 5V. It is characterized by extremely simple operation, high availability, and numerous support for many microcontrollers.
In a standard set of libraries and sample programs downloaded from the Arduino IDE environment, there is the Liquid Crystal library, which allows to operation presented display.
The alphanumeric display has 12 pins, which are not marked on the board. Each of them corresponds in turn to:
4 – RS – select display instruction register (low state) or data register (high state)
The display can be controlled in four modes:
8-bit without reading the busy flag – eight lines of the data bus and two control lines (RS, E – RW connected to GND) are needed for transmission,
8-bit with read busy flag – eight lines of the data bus and three control lines (RS, E, RW) are required for transmission,
4-bit with a readout of the busy flag – for transmission four lines of the data bus and three control lines are needed (RS, E, RW),
4-bit without readout of the occupancy flag – for transmission four lines of the data bus and two control lines are needed (RS, E – RW connected to ground).

The most often chosen communication mode is the 4-bit mode without reading the busy flag. Sending half a byte saves valuable I/O pins of the microcontroller – only four data lines are used (in 8-bit mode eight of them are occupied). Not reading the busy flag makes it necessary to use software delays, but saves another line – R/W. This pin can be permanently connected to the ground because data will be transported only one way – to the display.

name: Reed switch Module Pipe Magnetron Magnetic switch Module

blocks.text: Reed switch Module Pipe Magnetron Magnetic switch Module is a high-quality electronic component designed for Arduino, prototyping, and educational electronics.
The Mini Reed Switch Module activates a switch closure when a magnetic field comes near.
Key Features of Mini Reed Switch Module:
Outputs logic HIGH or LOW depending on if a magnetic field is near

Reed switches are mechanical switches that are activated by a magnet when the magnetic field pulls the metallic switch contacts together. Real-world uses include applications such as home security where a reed switch is placed in proximity to a magnet when a window is closed. If the window is opened, the magnet moves away from the switch which causes it to change states which can then be detected by an MCU.

This module is an SPST switch with NO (Normally Open) contacts until a magnet comes into proximity to the glass envelope and then the switch contacts are closed. The output is HIGH when the switch is open and is grounded (LOW) when the contacts are closed.

There is a 3-pin header on the assembly. The ‘-‘ pin is connected to the ground end of the switch and the ‘S ‘ output pin is connected to the other side of the switch. If an ohmmeter is placed between these two points, the switch will read open. If a magnet is placed close to the glass envelope, the switch will close and the meter will read close to 0 ohms.

There is a 3rd unmarked pin in the center that connects to a 10K pull-up resistor. You can either tie this pin to Vcc so that the pin will be pulled HIGH when the switch is open or you can enable an internal pullup on the pin that connects to the MCU.
Center pin = No connection or VCC
S = Signal output connects to a digital input pin on MCU

name: USB mini to TTL FTDI Board Module FT232RL Switchable 3.3V/5V

blocks.text: USB mini to TTL FTDI Board Module FT232RL Switchable 3.3V/5V is a high-quality electronic component designed for Arduino, prototyping, and educational electronics.
USB mini to TTL FTDI Board Module FT232RL Switchable 3.3V/5V

The USB mini to TTL FTDI Board Module FT232RL Switchable 3.3V/5V is a UART (universal asynchronous receiver-transmitter) board used for TTL serial communication. It is a breakout board for the FTDI FT232R chip with a USB interface, can use 3.3 or 5 V DC and has Tx/Rx and other breakout points.
This FTDI board is based on FTDI original chip FT232RL.
FT232R chips are one of the newer chips manufactured by FTDI (Future Technology Devices International).
Apart from being a USB to serial UART, it has an integrated EEPROM and optional clock generator output.
The chip also incorporates FTDI Chip-ID functionality (giving each chip a unique identifier for security) and USB termination resistors.
Cloned boards (with a cloned chip) will likely exclude the unique ID functionality and does not include an EEPROM, meaning that signals cannot be inverted.
Pins: 6 pin headers and 18 through-hole connectors. DTR, RX, TX, VCC, CTS, GND and PWR, TEN, SLEEP, CTS, 3.3V, 5V, RXL, TXL, GND x 2, TXD, DTR, RTS, VCC, RXD, R1, RSD, DCD (all marked)
The internal clock (6MHz, 12MHz, 24MHz and 48MHz) can be brought out of the device and used to drive a microcontroller or external logic.
The module has a mini-B USB port which is used to connect to an USB port of an interfaced device (e.g. a PC).
On the other side, the FTDI USB to TTL serial converter module has breakout pins (Tx, Rx, Vc and GND) that is connected to a microcontroller’s corresponding pins.
Communication takes place using TTL (transistor-transistor logic).
It has a 3.3/5V DC jumper and will supply 500mA through its Vc pin.
Data Terminal Ready (Used for auto-reset in Arduino Pro Mini)
Communication Protocol : UART (TX, RX), with CTS, RTS, DTR, DSR, RI support
EEPROM : Internal, configurable via FTDI software
Driver Support : Windows, macOS, Linux (VCP & D2XX drivers)
Connector Type : Standard 6-pin header (TX, RX, VCC, GND, CTS, DTR)

name: XL4015 Adjustable DC-DC Step-Down Module with Display 5A 75W

blocks.text: XL4015 Adjustable DC-DC Step-Down Module with Display 5A 75W is a high-quality electronic component designed for Arduino, prototyping, and educational electronics. XL4015 Adjustable DC-DC Step-Down Module with Display – 5A 75W Power Converter
High Current Capacity: Delivers up to 5A continuous output current, suitable for powering demanding devices. ​
Wide Input Voltage Range: Accepts input voltages from 4V to 38V, providing flexibility for various power sources. ​
Adjustable Output Voltage: Offers a continuously adjustable output from 1.25V to 36V to meet diverse application needs.
Module Properties: 5A High Power 75W DC-DC adjustable step-down module
Output voltage: DC 1.25V ~ 36V continuously adjustable ( the input voltage must be higher than the output voltage 1.5V )
Output current: max 5A, recommended for use in the 4.5A.
Measure range: 0 ~ 40V ( please ensure that the input voltage is 4.5V or more)
Output power: up to 75W, more than 50W, Please enhance heat dissipation
With overheat protection and short circuit protection
DC-DC Step-Down converters (also known as ‘Buck’ converters) convert a higher voltage to a lower voltage while also stepping up the available current.

This DC-DC Step-Down converter is adjustable and capable of outputting a voltage in the range of 1.25 to 35V at a continuous current of up to 4A and short-term current of up to 4.5A with a maximum power output of up to 75W. The input voltage must be higher than the output voltage.
The XL4015 converter IC has over current limiting and thermal shutdown features built-in.
There is an on-board green LED that illuminates when power is applied.
The module ships with a small heatsink that has adhesive pre-applied. The heatsink can be attached to the XL4015 converter IC to help keep it cool.

The board has 4 holes in the corners which can be used for mounting it permanently if desired using small screws. The module comes with 4 standoffs that can be installed into these holes to space the module up if desired for benchwork.
The built-in red voltmeter display shows the input and output voltage.

There are 2 buttons which control the display. The button on the left (near the Vin- terminal) turns the display on or off. The button on the right switches the display between displaying the input voltage and displaying the output voltage. There are two red LEDs marked ‘ IN ‘ and ‘ OUT ‘ that indicate which voltage is currently being displayed.
The display has a stated accuracy of ± 0.1V. Some versions of the module have a calibration sequence that can be performed to calibrate the display against a reference voltmeter if desired.
To calibrate the display, perform the following steps:
select the voltage reading (input or output) that you want to calibrate so that it is shown on the display.

Hold the right button down for approximately 2 seconds. When you release it, the display should be blinking which indicates that it is in the calibration mode. If the display is not blinking, then it is a version of the module that does not support the calibration process.

Use the left button to decrement the reading down and the right button to increment it up. Each press of the button adjusts the calibration by less than 0.1V, so you may need to press the button several times to see a change in the reading.
Once you are happy with the reading, press the right button again for approximately 2 seconds to save the setting.
The module has a multi-turn potentiometer for adjustment of the output voltage.
Turning the pot CW increases the output voltage while turning it CCW decreases the output voltage.

The lowest output voltage is approximately 1.25V. The upper limit of the adjustment range will depend on the input voltage and is typically about 1.5V less than the input voltage. With a 12V input for instance, the upper output limit will be approximately 10.5V.
These are compact boards with input power applied to one end and output power available on the other end.
With the LED display facing towards you, the input is on the left and the output is on the right. The connections are made using screw terminals for easy connection to wires for hookup.
The input has a reverse polarity protection diode.
Output power is available on the right side of the module. It also uses screw terminals for easy connection to wire for hookup.

These relatively new, super strong magnetic products contain powerful rare earth material and have become increasingly popular with customers from amateurs to industry leaders in almost every field. Whether your business involves heavy duty lifting and bonding or displaying fine artwork or commercial signage, there is an extremely strong Neodymium disc to suit your holding requirements. This is an ideal way of attaching and removing protective covers, privacy screens or shade cloth to a metal fixing point, which can include a metal washer or another disc magnet with the opposite pole.
Each magnet has its north and south poles on opposing circular faces.
Each magnet is coated with three layers of nickel, copper and nickel to give superior corrosion resistance and provide a smooth and clean finish.

Despite their compact size, these small neodymium rod magnets are impressively strong. Because these magnets are so small they are very versatile; they have many creative uses and are commonly used in packaging, displays, furniture and crafts.
All magnets may chip and shatter, but if used correctly can last a lifetime.
Not for children, parental supervision required.
If damaged please dispose of completely. Shards are still magnetized and if swallowed can inflict serious damage if magnets join inside the digestive tract.

74HC192-74192 (Decade Counter) is a high-quality electronic component designed for Arduino, prototyping, and educational electronics.
The 74192 is a Presettable Synchronous 4-Bit Up/Down Decade Counter.

Presetting the counter to the number on the preset data inputs (Input A – Input D) is accomplished by a LOW asynchronous parallel load input (Load). The counter is incremented on the low-to-high transition of the UP input (and a high level on the Clock- DOWN) and decremented on the low to high transition of the DOWN input (and a high level on the UP input). A high level on the CLR input overrides any other input to clear the counter to its zero state. The Terminal Count up (CO) goes low half a clock period before the zero count is reached and returns to a high level at the zero count.

The Terminal Count Down (BO) in the count down mode likewise goes low half a clock period before the maximum count (9 in the 74192) and returns to high at the maximum count. Cascading is effected by connecting the CO [carry] and BO [borrow] outputs of a less significant counter to the Clock-Up [UP] and Clock-Down [DOWN] inputs, respectively, of the next most significant counter.

Bluetooth Module HC-06 is a high-quality electronic component designed for Arduino, prototyping, and educational electronics.

HC-06 is a Bluetooth module designed for establishing short range wireless data communication between two microcontrollers or systems. The module works on Bluetooth 2.0 communication protocol and it can only act as a slave device. This is cheapest method for wireless data transmission and more flexible compared to other methods and it even can transmit files at speed up to 2.1Mb/s.
The difference between the master and slave

Paired only with the slave master, not with cell phones, computers and other pairing, can not be searched for two devices directly via Bluetooth serial communication, such as between the microcontroller and microcontroller serial cable with microchips, etc., using the method and serialthe same;

Computer, Bluetooth host, most mobile phones with Bluetooth, PDA, PSP and other intelligent terminals with Bluetooth pairing with a variety of functions from, from between the machine can not be paired.
Only one pairing between master and slave.

HC-06 uses frequency hopping spread spectrum technique ( FHSS ) to avoid interference with other devices and to have full duplex transmission. The device works on the frequency range from 2.402 GHz to 2.480GHz.

HC-06 module has six pins as shown in the pinout. In them we only need to use four for successfully interfacing the module. Some breakout boards will only leave four output pins only because of this reason.
The pin state determines whether the module works in AT command mode or normal mode
response mode), Low or NC= Bluetooth module normally working]
+5V Positive supply needs to be given to this pin for powering the module
Serial data is transmitted by module through this pin (at 9600bps by default), 3.3V logic
Serial data is received by module through this pin (at 9600bps by default),3.3V logic
The pin is connected to the LED on the board to represent the state of the module
Bluetooth protocol: Bluetooth V2.0 protocol standard
Modulation mode: Gauss frequency Shift Keying
HC-06 is best option when short distance wireless communication is needed. The module is used for wireless communications of less than 100 meters.
The module is very easy to interface and to communicate.
The module is one of the cheapest solutions for wireless communication of all types present in the market.
The module consumes very less power to function and can be used on battery operated mobile systems.
The module can be interfaced with almost all controllers or processors as it uses UART interface.
How to use HC-06 Bluetooth Module

The communication with this HC-06 module is done through UART interface . The data is sent to the module or received from the module though this interface. So we can connect the module to any microcontroller or directly to PC which has RS232 port (UART interface). A typical interface circuit of the module to an arduino is shown below.

Here the module is connected to +5V standard regulated power supply and UART interface is established as shown in figure. All you need to do is connect RXD of arduino to TXD of module and TXD of arduino is connected to RXD of module through a resistor voltage divider. This voltage divider is provided for converting 5V logic signal sent by arduino to +3.3V logic signals which are suitable for the module. The ground of arduino and module must be connected for voltage reference in case separate power sources are used.
After connecting the module you have to write the program in arduino IDE to receive and send data to the module. For successful wireless communication you need to remember a few things:
In programming you need to set default baud rate of UART serial communication to 9600. The value is default setting of module and can be change in program.

The module is a slave and so you need a master to establish a successful wireless interface. For that you need another [arduino + module (with master feature)] setup or you can use a smart phone as a master and search for HC-06 slave.
The master searches for slave and connects to it after authenticated with password. The HC-06 module has default password ‘1234’ which can be changed.
In program you can receive data master sends (After authentication) and perform tasks based on it.

Also you can download libraries for module through the websites and use them to make communication easy. All you need to do is download these libraries and call them in programs. Once the header file is included, you can use simple commands in the program to tell the arduino to send or receive data. The module sends this data to master through wireless Bluetooth. If the module receives any data from master, it will transmit it to arduino through UART serial communication.

You can also interface HC-06 to PC using RS232 cable. Once you interface is done you can use serial terminal on PC or any similar software to send or receive data to module. You need to type in AT command in serial terminal to communicate with the module and these commands can be downloaded here .

Easy to interface with timer or micron rollers (TTL compatible)
Can be easily cascaded with more IC to display a higher range of number
Note: Complete Technical Details can be found on the CD4026 datasheet given at the end of this page.

The IC CD4026 is an IC that can perform the function of both a counter as well a 7-segment Drive r. One single IC can be used to count from zero (0) to nine (9) directly on a Common Cathode type 7-segment display. The count can be increased by simply giving a high clock pulse; also more than one digit (0-9) can be created by cascading more than one CD4026 IC . So if you have a 7-segment (CC) display on which you have to display numbers that are being counted based on some condition then this IC will be a perfect choice.
How to use a CD4026 IC

The IC can work from 3V to 15V but is normally powered with +5V to the Vdd/Vcc pin, and the Ground/Vss pin is connected to the ground. We have 7 output pins named from Out A to Out G which is directly connected to the 7-segment display. The clock inhibits pin (pin 2) has to be held low (ground/0V) so that the clock signals can be sent to the IC also the Enable Input pin (pin 3) should be made high (+5V) so that the output pins (Out A to G) can be made active.

The 7-segment pins will increment the count by one number each time the clock pin (pin 1) is made high. This clock source can either be obtained from a 555 IC or any other digital IC that is TTL compatible. They simply have to generate a pulse of low voltage 0V and high voltage 5V. In the circuit below I have used a clock source of 1Hz to increment the count. So the number will get incremented for every (T=1/F) 1 second.

The Reset pin (pin 15) is used to reset the count back to zero when made high. There are three other output pins (pin 5,4,14) which will be used only when the IC needs to be cascaded. The pin Carry over (CO – pin 5) will stay high by default, but when the count reaches “9” it will give a small pulse and the count will continue from “0” again. This small pulse can be used to drive the clock pin of a cascaded IC to display more than one digit. The Direct Enable output (DEO) pin will always stay high, to enable any cascaded IC, if available. The Ungated C segment pin (pin 14) is used for any division operation; this pin will stay high by default and will go low when the count reaches “2”.

Moreover, the I2C interface uses only SDA and SCL for communication. Therefore, it saves valuable microcontroller pins compared with the standard parallel connection.
The display includes a blue backlight and clear character segments. In addition, the onboard potentiometer allows easy contrast adjustment.
Provides two rows of character data
Suitable for Arduino and embedded projects
Common I2C Addresses: 0x27 or 0x3F, Depending on Batch
The I2C board may increase the total assembled depth beyond the basic LCD panel dimensions.
First, connect VCC and GND to a suitable power source. Then, connect SDA and SCL to the matching I2C pins on your controller.
Next, install a compatible LCD I2C library. Use an I2C scanner if you do not know the module address.

Finally, adjust the onboard contrast potentiometer until the characters appear clearly. If the backlight works but no text appears, check the address, contrast setting, wiring, and software configuration.
This display suits projects such as:
The supplied I2C address may vary between production batches.
Use an I2C scanner before changing your program.
Do not reverse the VCC and GND connections.
The standard module normally operates from 5V.
Check I2C voltage compatibility when using 3.3V controllers.
Some backpacks contain pull-up resistors connected to 5V.
Use an I2C level shifter when your controller cannot tolerate 5V.
The displayed symbols depend on the LCD character set.
Images and minor board details may vary by batch.
